input.subject: Front door – Flat 12, 52 Meadow Row, Kingshaven, ZZ9 5ZZ (Ref R/PM014-1)
input.body:
Good morning,

Thank you for your reply about the front door at Flat 12, 52 Meadow Row, Kingshaven, ZZ9 5ZZ (ref R/PM014-1).

Before we put this off until next month, please be aware of the following:
- The current workaround is slamming the door to close it. Our contractor who fitted the fridge freezer saw it and warned that this could crack or shatter the glass in the door.
- The tenant says the door and frame wobble when it is shut. If this gets worse, the door may not close or lock properly. That would leave the flat insecure and need an emergency call-out.

Our recommendation is that a contractor inspects the door and frame soon, to find the cause and quote for the repair. Once we have the cost, we will come back to you for approval before any repair work.

Please reply with one of these:
- APPROVE: we arrange an inspection now
- NEXT MONTH: you prefer to wait until next month, and we will tell the tenant

Kind regards
Donna
Northbridge Lettings

input.subject: Front door – Flat 12, 52 Meadow Row (Ref R/PM014-1)
input.body:
Hello,

This is an update on the front door at Flat 12, 52 Meadow Row, Kingshaven, ZZ9 5ZZ (ref R/PM014-1). Your landlord has replied, and we are now confirming with them when a contractor can inspect the door. We will update you by 10 June.

In the meantime:
- Please close the door as gently as you can.
- Keep hands and faces away from the glass when shutting it.
- Contact us straight away if the glass cracks, or if the door will not close or lock. That would be treated as urgent.

Kind regards
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
